headline: Philip Morris International (PM) Puts €343 Billion EU Footprint At The Center
summary: Philip Morris International (NYSE:PM) released a new EU Economic Footprint Study reporting a €343b contribution to the European economy. The review shows smoke free products now account for more than half of PMI's net revenues in Europe. The study highlights PMI's links to employment and exports across EU markets and urges policy support for reduced risk products.
